evals.prompt: What colour palette do the portfolio sites in our design research share? Give me a few combinations I could use.
evals.expected_output: palettes/type/portfolio.md and .svg generated, and an answer naming the top background, text and accent with site counts and two or three combinations with contrast ratios and sources.
assertions: Runs palette.mjs on design-research grouped by type
Every colour named in the answer appears in palettes/type/portfolio.md
Every recommended combination has text contrast of at least 4.5:1 on its background
Says which combinations were seen on a real site and which are remixes
fixture_requirements: A design-research folder with Type lines filled in

evals.prompt: Compare the colours of the awwwards Design Agencies sites with the Portfolio ones.
evals.expected_output: Palettes built by awwwards category and a comparison of the two category files.
assertions: Notes that one site can be in both categories
Comparison cites site counts from the two files rather than impressions
fixture_requirements: A design-research folder with awwwards metadata in styles.json

evals.expected_output: Recognised as a design-probe task; this skill is not used to measure a site.
assertions: Does not run palette.mjs as a way to measure a new site
Points to or uses the design-probe skill instead
fixture_requirements: Network access, and the design-probe skill available
